[WITH DUPLICATES]] ..., [FILE STATUS], in any order after SELECT (§1985:IX.2.3.3 SR1: "The clauses which follow the SELECT clause may appear in any order"). Re-probed at 85 at dc1f2dcce8 (classes b, c, e): the full format (OPTIONAL, RESERVE 2 AREAS, DYNAMIC, two alternate keys one WITH DUPLICATES) writes and reads (W 00, R 00 K1A1D1); the terse form (no TO/IS/MODE/KEY/FILE) and a reordered entry compile; RequiredClauses/Screen refuse a missing ASSIGN or RECORD KEY (COBOL5701); ScreenClauseRepetition a second ORGANIZATION or FILE STATUS (COBOL2423); RESERVE 0 COBOL2386; prime key WITH DUPLICATES COBOL1970; OPTIONAL twice COBOL5506; RELATIVE KEY COBOL0863, RECORD DELIMITER COBOL2912; LOCK MODE, SHARING, ASSIGN USING, COLLATING SEQUENCE, SOURCE keys, SUPPRESS WHEN COBOL0900; a failed OPEN INPUT of a missing file gives 35 and the next READ 47. PARTIAL: PADDING CHARACTER, printed only in the sequential entry (§1985:VII.2.7.4 GR1: "The PADDING CHARACTER clause specifies the character which is to be used for block padding on sequential files"), is still accepted on an indexed entry: BindFileControl captures it into FileModel.Padding for every organization and EntryClauses has no sequential-format row for it.
